Subject: Scale validation readout — slot reservation and agenda

Team / Sara,

We need to lock a 60-minute readout for the scale validation run we completed last week. Goal: present the load test results (token throughput, p95 latency across sequences, memory/kv hit rates), discuss where the tuning landed vs. the targets, and align on next steps for canary rollout.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 7, 10:30–11:30
- Wed Dec 8, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Dec 9, 09:00–10:00

Sara — can you confirm which slot works for your team? Marcus / Karthik: please advise if you need additional time for the architecture deep-dive (I tried to keep it tight).

Draft agenda attached (benchmark-plan-v2.pdf) and a lightweight KPI sheet (kpi-sheet.xlsx). I'll update the Drive link after we lock a time.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference

Marissa — all three windows look ok on my side. If we want to include a 15–20 minute architecture deep-dive (compilation/kernel selection, batching knobs, fallback routing), I’d prefer Wed Dec 8 at 14:00. That slot gives Karthik a little extra time before EOD.

Also flagging one ask: can we make sure the canary config and the test harness (JIRA-OPS-1127) are visible in the run readout so Product can sign off on rollout thresholds? I added a short note in the KPI sheet.

—Marcus

I can do Wed Dec 8 at 14:00. If we need to push deeper into the kernel selection details I can allocate 10 extra minutes, but I agree the core readout should stay 60 minutes. Planning to cover:
- Test harness and reproduction steps (3 min)
- Throughput and latency breakdown by model variant (10 min)
- Kernel/quantization tuning summary (10 min)
- Cache/hot-prefix behaviors observed (10 min)
- Canary rollout proposal & thresholds (10 min)
- Q&A (17 min)

Will prep a 2-slide appendix for variance sources.

Karthik
